title: Bunny dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <!-- left leg kicking up -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='80' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#e8d8f0' transform='rotate(-30 33 80)'/>
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='75' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f5a8c8' transform='rotate(-30 29 75)'/>
  <!-- right leg planted -->
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='86' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#e8d8f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='88' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f5a8c8'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='20' ry='19' fill='#f0e4f8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#fdd8e8'/>
  <!-- left arm raised -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='55' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#f0e4f8' transform='rotate(-50 28 55)'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='48' r='5' fill='#f5a8c8'/>
  <!-- right arm up -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='52' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#f0e4f8' transform='rotate(40 73 52)'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='46' r='5' fill='#f5a8c8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='18' fill='#f0e4f8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='12' rx='6' ry='15' fill='#f0e4f8' transform='rotate(-12 40 12)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='13' rx='3' ry='10' fill='#f5a8c8' transform='rotate(-12 40 13)'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='12' rx='6' ry='15' fill='#f0e4f8' transform='rotate(12 61 12)'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='13' rx='3' ry='10' fill='#f5a8c8' transform='rotate(12 61 13)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#5a3a7a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#5a3a7a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose & mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#f5a8c8'/>
  <path d='M50 43.5 q-4 4 -7 1' stroke='#b57a9a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 43.5 q4 4 7 1' stroke='#b57a9a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='41' r='3' fill='#f8c0d8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='41' r='3' fill='#f8c0d8'/>
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <path d='M84 24 v-9 l7 -3 v9' stroke='#7fd8f0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='24' r='3' fill='#7fd8f0'/>
  <circle cx='89' cy='21' r='3' fill='#7fd8f0'/>
  <path d='M14 30 v-7 l6 -2.5' stroke='#ffe27f' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <circle cx='12.5' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#ffe27f'/>
</svg>
